proof_obligations.claim: The s label-specific gammoid extension queries induced by pushed label classes admit a smaller common representative certificate with size f(s)k^c for a universal c.
proof_obligations.verification: The exact joint query is Q(X,B)=Gamma(X)\B, where Gamma(X) requires simultaneous extension in every gammoid layer and B is an arbitrary uniform exclusion of size at most k-1. If |Gamma(X)|<=k, singleton exclusions force every edge of Gamma(X) into any exact representative. The cycle produced no bound on the union of such profiles, no exchange surrogate for correlated gammoid layers, and no conversion to a graph sparsifier. This closes the current route without disproving the general conjecture.
